comment: Every item in the game. value is the shop price in coins; shops buy back at 40%. Items don't stack unless stackable is true. tool.bonus is added to the chance of success per attempt. heals is hitpoints restored when eaten. equip: the slot it is worn in, its attack/strength/defence bonuses, and the level needed (Attack for weapons, Defence for armour; 1 when left out). Weapons attack every 4 ticks unless they give a speed; style picks the animation. Bows (style shoot) need a Ranged level, hit from up to `range` tiles away, and fire the best arrows in the pack that the player can use; ammo.strength is an arrow's strength bonus. Axes and pickaxes can be wielded and still work as tools. burn: the Firemaking level and XP for lighting a log with a tinderbox.
